label: Sherwin-Williams paint colours
source: Every current Sherwin-Williams colour (owner, 2026-11-13: "they should all be in the tool"), from Sherwin-Williams' own colour data (https://api.sherwin-williams.com/prism/v1/colors/sherwin, the source behind its colour tools), read 2026-11-13. Archived colours and duplicate records left out. Shortlist: the 12 most common cabinet colours in each of 5 families, judged from designer, painter and retailer articles and SW's bestseller and cabinet pages, 2024 to 2026 (sources in shortlist_sources). The prompts for the 60 shortlisted colours were written by hand; the rest are rough and generated from hue and lightness.
